description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores (%) of different models across six datasets—SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI—comparing the performance of MADLLM with and without various embedding strategies. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, while the horizontal axis lists the datasets. For each dataset, three bars represent different configurations: MADLLM w/o feature embedding (light green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). In the SMD dataset, all three models achieve high F1 scores, with MADLLM w/o feature embedding reaching approximately 95%, MADLLM w/o prompt pool at about 92%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at around 93%. In PSM, MADLLM w/o feature embedding achieves the highest score at approximately 98%, followed by MADLLM w/o skip embedding at about 96%, and MADLLM w/o prompt pool at around 78%. For SWaT, MADLLM w/o feature embedding scores around 92%, MADLLM w/o prompt pool at about 91%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at approximately 86%. In SMAP, MADLLM w/o feature embedding reaches about 94%, MADLLM w/o prompt pool at around 70%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at approximately 68%. For MSL, MADLLM w/o feature embedding scores around 88%, MADLLM w/o prompt pool at about 86%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at approximately 87%. In WADI, MADLLM w/o feature embedding achieves about 76%, MADLLM w/o prompt pool at around 60%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at approximately 70%. The chart shows that MADLLM w/o feature embedding generally performs well across most datasets, while MADLLM w/o prompt pool shows significantly lower performance in some cases, particularly in PSM and SMAP.
